proof_chain: The existing finite coprime mixed-generation theorem chooses one actual coefficient field for each class.
Native tensor and integral-closure maps transport the expansion to every actual completed normalization branch.
The actual branch mixed square and lower residue square annihilate each ramification-weighted restricted error.
Native residue-field norms retract every branch error, and the complete original-base weight sum gives the auxiliary fraction-field degree.
The previously published prime annihilator and the classwise coprime annihilator give equality by the native integer gcd lemma. Additive-hom extensionality gives the composite equality.

No Henselianity or completeness premise on the original rings, supplied branch-coordinate square, auxiliary mixed witness, or Milnor-group torsion-freeness premise.
